name: Air-Fryer Masala Corn and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 cup sweet corn kernels, thawed or boiled
¾ cup cooked chickpeas, patted dry
½ tsp each chilli powder, chaat masala and cumin
steps: Toss the corn and chickpeas with the oil, chilli powder, cumin and salt.
Cook for 10–12 minutes, shaking every 4 minutes, until the corn is lightly charred.
Toss with chaat masala, lemon juice, onion and coriander.
note: Chickpeas lift the protein and slow the carbohydrate release of the corn.
